summary: Restored draft was reviewed against latest failure evidence. The cited R15 audit column mismatch, chat report domain/controller mismatch, help article SQL alias, notification read idempotency path, and missing admin permission seeds are present as fixed in the current draft. Focused regression test and OpenAPI contract check pass. Backend Java compile could not complete because Maven dependency resolution needs network access to repo.maven.apache.org and the required BOMs are absent from the local cache.
commands_run: rg "supportGetHelpArticles|HelpArticle" contracts catalogs docs packages services/backend tests

blocker.detail: Targeted backend compile failed before compilation because org.springframework.boot:spring-boot-dependencies:pom:4.1.0 and software.amazon.awssdk:bom:pom:2.48.3 were absent locally and Maven could not fetch them from https://repo.maven.apache.org/maven2: Permission denied: getsockopt.
blocker.resolution: Provide network access to Maven Central or pre-populate the local Maven cache with the required BOMs, then rerun: mvn -f services\backend\pom.xml -pl access,boot -am -DskipTests compile, followed by the passing focused pytest and API contract checks.
blocker.worker_result_evidence: mvn -f services\backend\pom.xml -pl access,boot -am -DskipTests compile -> Non-resolvable import POM for spring-boot-dependencies:4.1.0 and software.amazon.awssdk:bom:2.48.3; Could not transfer artifact from central; Permission denied: getsockopt. python3 -m pytest tests/test_r15_notification_support_postgres.py -> 5 passed. python3 scripts/check_api_contract.py -> API_CONTRACT_OK client=131 admin=184 websocket=12 runtime_hashes=PASS.
